records.outcome: the chosen connectors are switched on or off for this conversation
steps: Click the "+" button in the chat interface
Enable or disable connectors for this conversation

evidence.quote: Use the "+" button in your chat interface to access "Connectors," where you can enable/disable connectors per conversation.

records.notes: The security guidance restates this as turning off connectors you aren't using with the toggles in the chat "+" menu's Connectors item.

records.outcome: the custom connector stores the fixed credential and sends it as a request header on every request to the server
preconditions: request header authentication is in beta and available to a limited set of organizations
a custom header name must be approved by Anthropic before Claude will send it
steps: In the Add custom connector dialog, open Request headers
Select a header name from the list, or choose Custom header to enter a different name
Enter the header value exactly as the server expects it, including any scheme such as Bearer and its trailing space
Choose whether the header is Required
Repeat for any additional headers, up to four

evidence.quote: In the Add custom connector dialog, open **Request headers**.

records.notes: The dialog section says that for an API key server you choose No sign-in and add the key under Request headers; headers may also accompany OAuth, except Authorization. Unapproved custom header names are rejected on save; approval is requested from Claude support.

records.notes: Authentication settings cannot be changed after adding; the text says to remove the connector and add it again with the new details, after which members must reconnect.

new_task.label: block a connector's individual tools for yourself
new_task.outcome: a specific tool on a connected connector is set to Blocked in the user's own connector settings, so Claude can no longer invoke it
new_task.why: T-023 covers an admin restricting tools for members and T-008 covers responding to the in-chat permission card; neither outcome covers an end user setting a tool's permission to Blocked in their own Customize > Connectors.

records.outcome: the selected tool's permission is set to Blocked so Claude cannot invoke it
steps: Set the tool's permission to Blocked

evidence.quote: Block individual tools you don't need under **Customize > Connectors** by selecting the connector and setting the tool's permission to **Blocked**

records.notes: Appears as a usage-guideline bullet but states concrete navigation and a control setting.
